name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 8 visits over 49 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.0 days starting 2026-05-04, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
